title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingSite
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingSite. Licensed plant in which waste is treated in accordance with the local laws (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.1.3.20). Subclass of geo:Feature, org:Site and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.6).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteProcessingSite'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the waste processing site, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.

acceptedWasteKinds.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from the object property 'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/accepts', whose range is the controlled vocabulary s4envi:WasteKind -- not modelled as its own entity. The waste kinds this site accepts. Known individuals (non-exhaustive): 'BiodegradableWaste', 'FoodWaste', 'GardenParkWaste', 'ConstructionWaste', 'ConcreteConstructionWaste', 'WoodConstructionWaste', 'WoodWaste', 'GlassWaste', 'HouseholdWaste', 'PaperCardboardWaste', 'PlasticWaste', 'TextileWaste'.

sfContains.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfContains'. A waste processing site spatially contains at least one waste processing device. (ontology restriction: minimum 1). Links to WasteProcessingDevice entities.

wasteProcessingCapacity.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingCapacity'. Maximal capacity of a waste processing site in terms of volume or mass of waste processed per unit of time. Unit not fixed by the ontology; example uses tonnes/day.
